learning_outcomes.text: Learn the basics of sound as a physical phenomenon and how hearing works as well as perception of sound.
Learn the basics of the anatomy of the ear, the function of nerve cells and the most important research methods in psychoacoustics.
Learn how different music instruments produce sound, how different rooms color the sound you perceive, and how human speech is produced.
Learn to solve related mathematical problems and analyze sounds with ready made tools.
Be able to learn more about acoustics independently and gain a good foundation for studying psychoacoustics and hearing function.

syllabus_topics: Properties of hearing (critical bands, masking phenomena, pitch perception)
Musical acoustics (sound production mechanisms of musical instruments)
Human speech production system (physiologically, signal type)
